title.narrative: Second Support to the Education Sector Project PASEN II

description.narrative: The objective of the Project is to: (a) improve the students retention rate in primary education schools located in participating municipalities; and (b) strengthen Ministry of Education's (MINED's) education management capacity. Specifically, the Project focuses on forty municipalities in six departments, and the two Atlantic Autonomous Regions- South Atlantic Autonomous Region (RAAS) and North Atlantic Autonomous Region (RAAN). Project components are as following: improving the schools' learning environment; improving the quality of teaching methods; and strengthening MINED's education management capacity.

The objectives of the Project are to: (a) improve the students' retention rate in Primary Education Schools located in Participating Municipalities; and (b) strengthen MINED's education management capacity.

title.narrative: Within-year retention rate for primary education in targeted municipalities

comment.narrative:
Data at baseline was collected and reported, and targets were set according to data available to MINED at the time. However, after a thorough revision of the values for this indicator during the timeframe of the Project, it was determined that this indicator could not be used due to the lack of reliability of the end-of-year enrollment rates collected by SINFO.
As such, this indicator cannot be measured and, thus, actual achieved values are not reported.
